candidate_workaround: Update generator-owned assertions at the generator and every authoritative count mirror before regeneration.
failure_signature: A generated targeted test reintroduces an obsolete ledger count after its direct file was corrected.
recurrence_guard: Trace every generated failure to its generator source and refresh all count-dependent mirrors together.
rollback: Retain the failed validator run, grant it zero pass credit, and do not commit the stale generated assertion.
scope_boundary: Owner-local x1 generated-test recovery only; no x2, canonical-final, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Correct generated count mirrors at their source
trigger_preconditions: A regenerated test or receipt restores a count that conflicts with the authoritative append-only ledger.
